units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: background pixels in empty corners differ by <0.2 grey levels between frame 0 and 71; background = per-pixel median of 12 frames is clean
camera.perspective: plain grey seamless cyclorama (studio backdrop). Wall-to-floor bend (brightening ramp) centred near y=1062 (ramp y~950-1150); no lines, no horizon, no vanishing points. Bird flies parallel to the image plane (2D clip); shadow on floor at y~1200-1250 stays at constant image height, consistent with constant depth.

objects.name: phoenix
objects.description: the only moving object: a colourful fantasy bird (phoenix) - green head/neck/torso with yellow beak, purple/pink/red flapping wings, long orange-red tail plumes with peacock-eye spots ending in a yellow-green flame-shaped tip; a faint translucent flame/smoke wisp in front of the beak
objects.occluded: never occluded by anything else; fully inside frame in all frames (self-occlusion of head/torso by wings in some frames)
objects.motion: flies right-to-left, roughly horizontally, speeding up; flaps wings with ~25-frame period. Body x ~1541 (frame 0) -> ~315 (frame 71); body y stays 667-731 (bobbing with wingbeat).
objects.reference_point_recommended: body_s_x, body_s_y (smoothed green-torso centroid, best proxy for the rig root/origin); alternatives: body_x/y (raw), head_x/y (head, rigid feature, valid where head_ok=1), centroid_x/y (whole-mask centroid, wing-biased), bbox_cx/cy

size_px.note: horizontal extent is beak-wisp to tail tip; vertical extent is dominated by the wings (wings up or down = tall, wings level = short ~252-260 px)

objects.name: phoenix_shadow
objects.description: dark grey shadow of the phoenix on the light floor directly below it
objects.note: image y ~1195-1260; follows bird's x (offset slightly, shadow mask centroid cx is ~+175 px right of body x at frame 0, shrinking to ~-20 px at frame 71; it is the whole-bird shadow incl. tail, so it relates to centroid_x rather than body_x)

objects.name: backdrop
objects.description: seamless grey studio cyclorama: darker grey wall (grey ~95-108) curving into light floor (grey ~215-221)

events.event: no contact, impacts or direction reversals; bird keeps flying left for whole clip; clip ends with bird still in frame
